title: Two Suspects Detained With Drugs in Chalco, State of Mexico, on Suspicion of CJNG Cell Ties
detail: On September 3, 2026, the Mexico State Security Secretariat's Fuerza de Acción y Reacción (FAR) detained Valentín 'N,' 41, and Francisco 'N,' 26, in the Covadonga neighborhood of Chalco, State of Mexico, after a citizen report of individuals handling bags of illicit substances. Officers seized 61 bags of marijuana, 65 packets of rock cocaine, 9 envelopes of powder cocaine, and 7 packages of crystal methamphetamine. Authorities said the pair could be connected to a criminal group 'originario de Jalisco' and opened an investigation to determine whether they are formally tied to a CJNG cell operating in the region; no CJNG affiliation has been confirmed.

media.caption: State of Mexico security forces display drugs seized from two suspects detained in Chalco on suspicion of CJNG ties

confidenceReason: The drug seizure and arrest are reported by two Tier-2 outlets, but the suspects' link to CJNG is explicitly described by authorities as unconfirmed and under investigation.
